reports.title: Novocure Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Raises 2026 Guidance

guidance.heading: 2026 Financial Guidance
section: Novocure’s updated guidance for the full year 2026, as of October 29, 2026, is summarized below:
•Total net revenue: $736 million - $743 million (previous: $710 million - $725 million)

This guidance assumes full-year mid-to-high single digit net revenue growth from Optune Gio, net revenue contribution from Optune Lua and Optune Pax, collectively, between $30 million and $34 million, foreign exchange rates as of September 30, 2026, and quarterly gross margin in the mid-to-high 70s percent.
